title: Fireflies

Fireflies

Fireflies are a resource in Oaklands; they provide an alternative means of making money that does not rely on trees or stone nodes. At night, fireflies will begin to spawn around the map in random locations (usually on the surface). These fireflies form clustered groups, illuminating the area around them. A player can use a Jar to catch them, and then can bring them back to the Resource Hub to sell them.

  • Jars can easily bought at the Oak Depot, although many other stores offer them as well.
  • After an update, selling fireflies no longer consumes the Jar. Instead, it consumes the fireflies inside the jar and gives the jar back.

Fireflies spawn in different colors, each variation having a different value. The table below is listed by rarity, with yellow being the most common and purple being the rarest.

    Firefly Chances
    Yellow, common rarity, has a ~84% or ~8/10 spawn chance.
    Green, common rarity, has a 10% or 1/10 spawn chance.
    Red, common rarity, has a 5% or 1/20 spawn chance.
    Blue, uncommon rarity, has a 0.9% or roughly ~1/100 spawn chance
    Purple, rare rarity, is the rarest variant. Has a <0.1% or 1/1000 spawn chance.
    • Unconfirmed if weather conditions changes the spawning of fireflies.
    • Location does not change the chances of a particular firefly color spawning.
    • Using Freecam, you can see that most Fireflies do not spawn until a player is in (or travels through) the area.
      • As such, to maximize your chances of finding rare Fireflies, drive to unloaded areas and observe the new Fireflies that spawn there.
    • Blue and Purple Fireflies have higher value trading compared to just selling them.
    • All fireflies that are not bottled disappear at 6:30.
    Image Color Variant Sell Value
    Yellow Fireflies Jar Jar of Yellow Fireflies $450
    Green Fireflies Jar Jar of Green Fireflies $550
    Red Fireflies Jar Jar of Red Fireflies $800
    Blue Fireflies Jar Jar of Blue Fireflies $2,400
    Purple Fireflies Jar Jar of Purple Fireflies $4,400

    Events

    2023 and 2024 Halloween Ghosts

    During Halloween 2023/2024, fireflies were replaced by Ghosts. While they were otherwise functionally identical, Ghosts had the quirk of not disappearing during the day. Ghosts were sold for the event currency, Candy, instead of for money. Player would receive their empty Jar back. The chances for the colors of Ghosts is likely the same.

    Image Color Variant Sell Value
    Jar of Yellow Ghosts 450 Candy
    Jar of Green Ghosts 550 Candy
    Jar of Red Ghosts 800 Candy
    Jar of Blue Ghosts 2400 Candy
    Jar of Purple Ghosts 3400 Candy

    Trivia

    • For a time after the 2023 Halloween Update, fireflies inherited the quirk of ghosts, where they did not disappear during the daytime. This glitch was rectified in a later update.
